# Approved project glossary

Synthetic project fixture. Scope: Product A, version 3, Chinese operator notes.

| English concept | Approved Chinese wording | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| sync point | 同步点 | A recorded position updated after a checkpoint completes |

For this project, use 同步点 for that recorded position. 同步节点 denotes a node
and is not approved for this concept. Preserve EXAMPLE_MODE and the configuration
file path exactly. This glossary does not cover Product B or performance claims.
